description: Focused capability verification of the three Negotiation-T fromData generation interfaces: generateNegotiationProposePromptFromData, generateNegotiationAcceptPromptFromData and generateNegotiationRejectPromptFromData. Inputs are pure structured JSON - each item is one key (the slot name) with its value (the field content); no natural-language passages, no non-negotiation interfaces involved. Generation is deterministic rendering (no LLM call), so assertions are exact: the generated prompt must carry every item name and value, the propose relationship sentence, and the matching template URI; negative cases feed an empty item set or a phase-mismatched template and expect a failure. The information negotiation type is exercised; target/feasibility variants are covered by the fromData sample demo.
